result.summary: The page is largely functional and well-structured; no critical defects are apparent. The main issues are minor visual/styling inconsistencies in the status bar and carousel card alignment, plus a potential clarity gap in the promotional messaging.

issues.description: The status bar at the top of the screen is rendered with oversized, oversized-looking black text and icons, making it visually inconsistent with the rest of the app's interface.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the status bar inherits the app's typography and spacing, or render it as part of a proper system header with standard sizing.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel cards have inconsistent widths and appear clipped/overlapping at the right edge, with the third card's image and time badge cut off by the screen boundary.
issues.suggestion: Use uniform card widths with consistent spacing and let the row scroll cleanly, keeping partially visible cards aligned with the others.

issues.description: The promotional banner mentions '3 free deliveries' with code TALLINN3, but a separate restaurant listing shows '€0 delivery' for a different offer, and the pizza card below shows '-20%', which may be confusing given the banner's min. order condition of €10.
issues.suggestion: Clarify the promotion terms (e.g., add the minimum order amount directly to the code text) and visually distinguish the free-delivery promo from individual restaurant discounts.
